record.one_liner: Zoho CRM: cloud customer relationship management (leads, contacts, deals) with a public REST API.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow via a connected app (client ID and secret) and the Zoho accounts /oauth/v2/token endpoint. No API key or basic auth documented in the pages read.
record.access_notes: The API limits page lists a Free Edition with a 5000 credit daily allowance. The Free Edition row was read from the official API limits page.
record.api_notes: Official v8 API docs cover OAuth, tokens and per-call credit usage. Breadth was not verified object by object; the rating is a judgement from the docs index only.
record.blocker_notes: Free Edition credentials are self-serve. MCP calls use the same API credits and need an OAuth login on first use.

evidence.quote: The Zoho CRM API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication.
Each API call made will result in a reduction of 1 credit.
Zoho CRM MCP servers connect your AI tools to Zoho CRM using the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
When you invoke an MCP tool for the first time, the server initiates an OAuth flow.
